name: Hacker Pride
main_effect:
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Pulsemon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・By placing the top card of 1 of your level 4 or higher Digimon with [Pulsemon] in its text on top of your security stack, gain 2 memory.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Pulsemon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
